records.finding: attribute_contributions and ability_multipliers exist in reward JSON but are not parsed into RewardProfile and therefore do not affect EquipmentScaler.
records.mechanism: BalanceDataParser.parseRewards constructs RewardProfile(item_id, source_boss, category); RewardProfile has exactly those three components; EquipmentScaler adds only Progression enchantment contributions.

records.finding: Frost-only blanket special multipliers [2.7, 2.8, 3.2, 5.0, 5.0] were removed. Native damage, the registered-boss tier boost, hosted participant factors and x0.88 remain; Raid is unchanged.
records.mechanism: Frost no longer declares special_damage_multiplier in expanded_bosses.json. This removes amplification of every hurt channel, including basic melee; it is an intentional scoped balance decision, not an observed DPS result.

records.finding: Blood Moon Armor Penetration is post-mitigation damage amplification, not removal of a fraction of armor/toughness.
records.mechanism: LivingDamageEvent amount is divided by (1 - min(0.30, penetration)); the event is after armor mitigation. The player debuff is another damage multiplier.

records.finding: Tier III Progression chest guard requires incoming LivingHurtEvent amount >=8 before its reductions; cooldown commits only after that hit decreases health or absorption.
records.mechanism: ProgressionArmor reserves the unchanged 35% guard in a native actuallyHurt transaction; a try/finally boundary commits the unchanged 240-tick cooldown only for that call's own net pool loss, excluding nested same-target damage.

records.finding: The current main branch does not grant artificial infinite durability or default max-damage values to progression/boss equipment. Eligible equipment keeps native wear, Mending and Unbreaking; dropped-item protection is a separate loss-prevention rule.
records.mechanism: Current module logic lock and localization explicitly preserve normal durability; no InfiniteEquipmentDurability production class exists in the current source tree.

records.finding: Installed Ignitium and Cursium armor implementations explicitly return false from isDamageable(ItemStack). Their ArmorMaterial still exposes nominal max-damage values, but runtime wear is disabled for those exact item classes.
records.mechanism: Ignitium_Armor.isDamageable and Cursium_Armor.isDamageable each return iconst_0 directly; nominal material durability therefore must not be reported as effective break capacity.

records.finding: Installed Epic Fight/Nightfall armor capabilities expose stun_armor and weight as a separate combat layer; they are not vanilla armor or toughness and are not folded into vanilla damage mitigation.
records.mechanism: Exact item capability JSON is attached per defense ID. The defensive matrices preserve the capability values but calculate HP loss only from proven vanilla armor/toughness and explicitly named incoming reducers.
sources: installed Epic Fight/Nightfall item capability JSON

records.finding: skarrier_mobs:ban_sword registers BanSwordItem with an exact +1499 attack-damage modifier and -2.4 attack-speed modifier, producing 1500 basic melee damage with the vanilla player base attribute.
records.mechanism: BanSwordItem constructs its main-hand AttributeModifier map with literal attack damage 1499. The current Atlas has no linked recipe, loot or other acquisition route, so player accessibility is unresolved rather than assumed.
